items.message: Caller-supplied `inp.env` is merged into the sandbox's environment without any constraint on key or value content.

The `cmd` list assembled for `CommandRun` includes `inp.command` verbatim; if the underlying sandbox does not enforce a no-shell execution path, caller-controlled tokens become argv elements that may alter command behaviour.
`inp.cwd` from the caller overrides the bound working directory and is passed to the sandbox without validation.
Makefile target names read from the repository are used as command arguments without sanitisation.
